messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patients less than 3 years"
set: ["patients less than 3 years", "pediatric patients less than 6 years old", "patients younger than 18 years old", "1% to less than 5% of patients", "less than two-fold", "patients without an ejection fraction less than 40%", "3 years and older", "children from birth to less than 18 years of age", "pediatric patients with glomerular filtration rate less than 30 mL/min", "40 mg/kg/day for patients 3 to 4 years of age", "parenteral administration recommended for patients aged 1 month to 12 years weighing less than 40 kg", "pediatric patients younger than 6 years with type 1 diabetes", "300 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older", "pediatric patients greater than or equal to 6 years of age", "passing much less urine than usual", "600 mg 3 times a day for patients 12 years and older"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
